title: SMS Marketing Pricing & Plans: Affordable Costs | Textedly

facts.fact: Textedly lists '1,600 Character Messaging' as one of its SMS features, per the vendor's own feature navigation.
facts.quote: 1,600 Character Messaging

facts.fact: Textedly's main 'Get Started Now' call-to-action links to account creation on a free subscription plan.
facts.quote: https://application.textedly.com/create-account/?subscription_plan=free

facts.fact: Textedly states that users can send their first text without contracts or a credit card, per its own marketing copy.
facts.quote: no contracts, no credit card, no hassle.

facts.fact: Textedly's payments product states it accepts payments from VISA, Mastercard, AMEX, Discover, Google Pay and Apple Pay using the customer's own SMS merchant account.
facts.quote: Take payments from VISA, Mastercard, AMEX, Discover, Google & Apple Pay with your own SMS merchant account.

facts.fact: Textedly's Email Marketing product is labeled 'Coming Soon' on its navigation, meaning it was not yet available when the page was captured.
facts.quote: (COMING SOON)

facts.fact: Textedly's pricing page states that the same features are included on every plan.
facts.quote: Same Features on Every Plan

facts.fact: Textedly pricing starts at $29 per month and scales with message volume.
facts.quote: Textedly pricing starts at $29/month and scales with your message volume.

facts.fact: Textedly's Bronze plan costs $49 per month billed monthly for 1,000 messages per month.
Textedly's Plus plan costs $79 per month billed monthly for 2,000 messages per month.
Textedly's Business plan costs $299 per month billed monthly for 10,000 messages per month.
Textedly's Platinum plan costs $1,920 per month billed monthly for 100,000 messages per month.
Textedly's Legend plan costs $5,520 per month billed monthly for 300,000 messages per month, the highest listed tier.
Textedly's annual billing option provides 20% more messages per month than monthly billing.
facts.quote: pay month-to-month or annually and get 20% more texts per month

facts.fact: Inbound messages on Textedly are free.
facts.quote: Incoming messages are completely free.

facts.fact: Textedly does not require long-term contracts; customers can pay month-to-month or annually.
facts.quote: No. Pay month-to-month or annually. Accounts with annual payments get 20% more texts per month.

facts.fact: Textedly charges $10 per month for each additional teammate, with no limit on the number of teammates.
facts.quote: There’s no limits on the number of teammates you can have. Add as many as you want. It's $10 per month to add a teammate.

facts.fact: Textedly's free account includes 50 free text messages and one custom keyword with no credit card required.
facts.quote: we'll start you off with 50 free text messages and one custom keyword so you can explore our platform at your own pace. No credit card required

facts.fact: Textedly's referral program pays a 20% monthly commission on a referred customer's subscription for an entire year.
facts.quote: we’ll reward you with a 20% monthly commission on their subscription for an entire year.

facts.fact: Textedly pays the registration cost for the first 10DLC phone number, while standard carrier fees apply to additional registered 10DLC numbers.
facts.quote: we pay the entire 10DLC registration cost for your first 10DLC phone number! For any numbers you register beyond that, standard carrier fees apply.

facts.fact: Toll-free numbers on Textedly require zero registration fees.
facts.quote: Getting started with a toll-free phone number requires absolutely zero registration fees.

facts.fact: Each Textedly account includes one free Toll-Free phone number and one free 10DLC phone number.
facts.quote: Each Textedly account includes a free Toll-Free phone number and a free 10DLC phone number.

facts.fact: Textedly allows SMS messages of up to 1,600 characters and MMS messages of up to 1,600 characters, versus the 160-character standard cited by the vendor for most platforms.
facts.quote: allow you to send up to 1,600 characters in an SMS message and up to 1,600 characters in an MMS message

facts.fact: Textedly states that SMS messages have a 98% open rate, versus email's 20%.
facts.quote: SMS messages have a 98% open rate, far surpassing email's 20%.

facts.fact: Textedly states that text messaging delivers 10x better open rates than email.
facts.quote: Text messaging delivers 10x better open rates than email, making it the most direct channel to reach your customers.

facts.fact: Textedly says account sign-up takes under 2 minutes and requires no credit card.
facts.quote: Sign up in under 2 minutes. No credit card required.

facts.fact: Textedly lets users choose a plan that fits their message volume or start free and upgrade at any time.
facts.quote: Choose the plan that fits your message volume or start free and upgrade anytime.

facts.fact: Textedly's homepage says there is no limit on how many contacts a user can store.
facts.quote: No limit on how many contacts you store.

facts.fact: Textedly states its SMS messages can be up to 1,600 characters, and its MMS messages up to 1,600.
facts.quote: SMS up to 1,600 characters. MMS up to 1,600.

facts.fact: Textedly's pricing page states that sending a first text requires no contracts and no credit card.
facts.quote: Send your first text in minutes—no contracts, no credit card, no hassle.

facts.fact: Textedly's page displays a trust badge stating it has 1,500+ reviews on G2, Google, and Trustpilot.
facts.quote: Based on 1,500+ reviews
